questions.question: What does David resolve in Psalm 101?
options: To build a great house for the name of the LORD
To drive out all his foes from the land
To walk with integrity of heart in his house
To gather great riches for his royal line
questions.answer: To walk with integrity of heart in his house

questions.question: What kind of person will David not endure?
options: One who slanders his neighbor secretly and has a proud heart
One who reverently fears the LORD and keeps all his commandments
One who is wise in his counsel and faithful in all his service
One who is poor and humble and walks always in his integrity
questions.answer: One who slanders his neighbor secretly and has a proud heart
